The Problem

Global trade decisions are still made with partial visibility.

Logistics teams are exposed to sudden route closures, fuel spikes, sanctions, and labour actions, often relying on emails, spreadsheets, and static PDFs to make multi‑million dollar calls.

Unpredictable port closures, weather, and political shocks.

Rising fuel and logistics costs with no clear route comparison.

Manual, undocumented decisions that are hard to defend.

The Solution

From noisy signals to a single, defensible route decision.

SupplyGuard AI converts fragmented global risk indicators into one clear 0–10 rating per route, backed by factor breakdowns, live intelligence, and executive‑ready reports.

  • • Combines fuel, politics, labour, sanctions, and weather into one view.
  • • Shows interactive routes on a 3D globe for quick situational awareness.
  • • Generates PDF, CSV, and print‑ready summaries for leadership in seconds.

Who it is for

  • • Logistics managers and network planners
  • • Supply chain and S&OP teams
  • • Risk and compliance analysts
  • • Operations and finance leadership

Designed for institutional and enterprise planning — not consumer or hobby use.

How it works

  1. 1. Select a trade route – from country, to country, product type, and sensitivity.
  2. 2. Ingest live and historical signals – fuel, politics, labour, sanctions, and weather.
  3. 3. Compare alternatives – benchmark multiple routes side‑by‑side on score and drivers.
  4. 4. Export and share – send a PDF, CSV, or print‑ready summary to decision‑makers.

Outcomes

  • • Fewer surprise disruptions and costly re‑routes.
  • • Clear justification for chosen routes.
  • • Faster cross‑team alignment on risk posture.

Built for trust

  • • Transparent factor‑wise breakdown.
  • • Uses real‑world risk indicators and news intelligence.
  • • No tracking and no third‑party cookies in the platform.

Reports & Exports

Decision‑makers live in email, slide decks, and PDFs. SupplyGuard AI meets them there with export‑ready outputs.

  • • One‑click PDF route risk reports.
  • • CSV exports for analysts and spreadsheets.
  • • Print‑friendly summaries for board packs.
  • • Shareable dashboard links with encoded route state.

Why it matters

Every high‑stakes routing decision should be defensible. The platform produces a clear narrative: what was known, what was chosen, and why.

That turns route selection from “best guess” into a repeatable, auditable process.
